description: Header file defining the EGLConsumer class, which manages EGL images and textures for SurfaceTexture in Android, including buffer management, context attachment/detachment, and synchronization.

classes.name: EGLConsumer
classes.description: Manages EGL images and textures for SurfaceTexture, handling buffer acquisition, release, context attachment/detachment, and synchronization.

classes.name: EglImage
classes.description: Utility class for creating, tracking, and binding EGLImageKHR objects from GraphicBuffer instances.

methods.name: updateTexImage
methods.description: Acquires the most recent buffer and updates the target texture with its contents.

methods.name: releaseTexImage
methods.description: Releases the texture acquired in updateTexImage.

methods.name: detachFromContext
methods.description: Detaches the EGLConsumer from the current OpenGL ES context, deleting associated textures.

methods.name: attachToContext
methods.description: Attaches a detached EGLConsumer to a new OpenGL ES context with a specified texture.

methods.name: onAcquireBufferLocked
methods.description: Updates internal buffer state when a buffer is acquired.

methods.name: onReleaseBufferLocked
methods.description: Updates internal buffer state when a buffer is released.

methods.name: onFreeBufferLocked
methods.description: Frees buffer slot resources, including EGLImage and references.

methods.name: createIfNeeded
methods.description: Creates an EGLImage if necessary, based on display and crop rectangle.

methods.name: bindToTextureTarget
methods.description: Binds the EGLImage to a specified OpenGL texture target.

methods.name: doGLFenceWaitLocked
methods.description: Inserts a fence wait command into the GL command stream for synchronization.

methods.name: syncForReleaseLocked
methods.description: Performs synchronization to safely release a buffer slot.
